item.title: ParadeDB Search Performance Improvements
item.description:

Postgres identifies its rows by ctid values.

item.title: Micron CEO Says Memory Supply Will Be Much Tighter in 2027 and 2028 Than in 2026
item.description:
📝 Thursday, October 1st 2026 Micron CEO Says Memory Supply Will Be Much Tighter in 2027 and 2028 Than in 2026 by DrUsmanSaleem Today, 05:26 Discuss (39 Comments) Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra says memory and storage supply will likely be much tighter in 2027 and 2028 than it was in 2026. Here's what he said:Industry demand has strengthened since our last earnings call, and we expect memory and storage supply-demand conditions to be much tighter in fiscal 2027 and 2028 than they were in 2026. In June, Micron CEO said they expected industry supply to improve gradually in 2028, but couldn't predict when supply would catch up with demand.
🔗 Read more: https://www.techpowerup.com/353296/micron-ceo-says-memory-supply-will-be-much-tighter-in-2027-and-2028-than-in-2026

item.title: Cops Can Bypass iPhone's Automatic Reboot to Get into Locked Phones
item.description:
📝 A company that makes phone hacking devices claims to have developed a solution that freezes iPhones in a state that lets cops more easily access sensitive data inside them, according to a video obtained by 404 Media. “We're gonna be able to preserve that data for an infinite amount of time. Once initial access is gained and the device is in a preserved state, we also disable all of those radios to make sure that that data cannot reach that device.
🔗 Read more: https://www.404media.co/cops-can-bypass-iphone-automatic-inactivity-reboot-graykey/
